Downtown Durham.name: Downtown Durham
Downtown Durham.description: City-core of Durham's revitalization with tower, office-to-residential, and hospitality permitting around the ballpark and Main Street.

Duke University & West Campus.name: Duke University & West Campus
Duke University & West Campus.description: University-anchored edge with institutional demand, graduate-housing construction, and West Campus expansion permits.

Ninth Street District.name: Ninth Street District
Ninth Street District.description: Corridor of retail, student housing, and mixed-use infill between downtown and the Duke campus.

Trinity Park & Old West Durham.name: Trinity Park & Old West Durham
Trinity Park & Old West Durham.description: Historic streetcar-era bungalow districts with renovation-led permitting and neighborhood-conservation overlays.

Northgate & Duke North.name: Northgate & Duke North
Northgate & Duke North.description: Northern growth edge with master-planned residential and North Durham commercial redevelopment near the beltline.

Roxboro Road Corridor.name: Roxboro Road Corridor
Roxboro Road Corridor.description: Arterial corridor with infill multifamily, aging retail teardown/rebuild, and transit-adjacent reinvestment.

Bahama & Northern Edge.name: Bahama & Northern Edge
Bahama & Northern Edge.description: Exurban northern boundary of the metro with low-volume, high-lot residential permitting.

East Durham & Holloway.name: East Durham & Holloway
East Durham & Holloway.description: Established inner-ring neighborhoods with storefront renewal, infill housing, and corridor-scale improvement.

Wheeler Hill.name: Wheeler Hill
Wheeler Hill.description: Hill-edge residential district with renovation capital and steady teardown/rebuild pressure.

Lyon Park.name: Lyon Park
Lyon Park.description: Transitional east-side neighborhood with housing rehabilitation and small-lot development.

Southpoint & 15-501.name: Southpoint & 15-501
Southpoint & 15-501.description: Southern retail and mixed-use hub with continued multifamily and commercial permitting around the 15-501 / 54 interchange.

Hope Valley & Croasdaile.name: Hope Valley & Croasdaile
Hope Valley & Croasdaile.description: Established southwest neighborhoods with renovation-led permits and estate-stock teardown/rebuild.

Lakewood & Woodcroft.name: Lakewood & Woodcroft
Lakewood & Woodcroft.description: Southwest residential hills with infill housing and corridor densification near Duke and Southpoint.

Research Triangle Park Edge.name: Research Triangle Park Edge
Research Triangle Park Edge.description: Southern edge shading into Research Triangle Park with employment-adjacent commercial and residential permitting.

Eno River & Hillsborough Rd.name: Eno River & Hillsborough Rd
Eno River & Hillsborough Rd.description: Northwest river-edge edge with protected greenway, estate stock, and limited new-construction pressure.

Parkwood.name: Parkwood
Parkwood.description: Post-war west-side residential corridor with steady redevelopment and corridor densification.
